Package fr.cytech.safeexit.model.simulation

package fr.cytech.safeexit.model.simulation
  • Class
    Description
    EventPhase
    Phase of the event being supervised.
    SimulationClock
    Holds the timing parameters of the simulation: the interval between two cycles (in milliseconds) and whether the clock is running.
    SimulationEngine
    Drives the simulation one cycle at a time.
    SimulationSerializer
    Saves and restores a SimulationState to and from a binary file, as required by the brief.
    SimulationSerializer.InvalidSimulationFileException
    Thrown when a file does not contain a valid SafeExit simulation.
    SimulationState
    Snapshot of everything that makes up a running simulation: the Graph, the list of Agents and the routing information.
